root_cause.text: In net/core/skbuff.c, skb_segment_list() continued to transfer fragment truesize from the parent SKB after GRO fraglist entries were changed to be orphaned (skb->sk = NULL), so socket memory accounting was subtracted from the head without any corresponding charge on the fragments, leaving sk_wmem_alloc permanently under-released.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says commit ed4cccef64c1 made fraglist entries orphaned while “the corresponding accounting logic in skb_segment_list() was never updated,” and the patch removes `delta_truesize += nskb->truesize;` and `skb->truesize = skb->truesize - delta_truesize;` while adding `DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE(nskb->sk);` to assert fragments should no longer carry a socket.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix skb_segment_list() to stop incorrectly reducing skb->truesize during segmentation while still updating the packet length fields.
intent_record.what: The assignment that subtracts delta_truesize from skb->truesize in skb_segment_list() was removed, while the subsequent updates to skb->data_len and skb->len remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the original skb no longer has its truesize reduced during list segmentation, preserving its memory accounting value while still decreasing its data_len and len to reflect the removed payload. This avoids incorrect truesize adjustment during segmentation.
